svg.title: Port-to-bell adapter - 7 rings of 1 ply, 21mm, 7 x 14 port to a 10mm square throat
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. The section runs from the cheek's 7 x 14 port to the bore's 10mm square, holding area on a smoothstep so both ends are tangent. The last ring is a collar, 10mm square in a 16mm square face: that is the bore's own end face, so the bell stacks on it unchanged. Each ring is 1 lamination(s) of 3mm ply, 3mm of rise, seating on the ring below over 3mm per side. Rings stack; they do not telescope. No kerf compensation: these are glued, as bell.py's are. The wide side of each ring lies ALONG the duct; the narrow side goes across the cheek's band. orange #ff8000 cuts the apertures first, black #000000 frees the rings.
